integrity: Proof is analytic except for two rigorously bounded elementary determinant evaluations by a standalone exact-rational interval checker; numeric root estimates are not a certificate.
scientific_limitations: Proves at least one non-frame lattice on αβ=4/5 only; no uniqueness, classification, or p>4 proof. Equivalence with unindexed literature remains a residual originality risk.
title: A rigorous four-fifths non-frame obstruction for an even rational Gabor window
